type: ∀ {α : Type} {a b : List α}, BucketMath.Similarity.Edit a b → BucketMath.Similarity.Within 1 a b

type: Type

type: BucketMath.Split.Parts → Nat

name: BucketMath.Split.author_floor
type: ∀ (nodeBps nodeFloor amount : Nat), 80 * amount ≤ 100 * (BucketMath.Split.split nodeBps nodeFloor amount).author

name: BucketMath.Split.author_tight
type: ∀ (nodeBps nodeFloor amount : Nat), 100 * (BucketMath.Split.split nodeBps nodeFloor amount).author < 80 * amount + 100

name: BucketMath.Split.bpsDenominator
type: Nat

name: BucketMath.Split.dust_to_author
type: ∀ (nodeBps nodeFloor amount : Nat), amount < 5 → (BucketMath.Split.split nodeBps nodeFloor amount).author = amount

name: BucketMath.Split.intermediates_fit
type:
∀ (nodeBps amount : Nat),
  amount < BucketMath.Split.uint256Bound →
    nodeBps ≤ BucketMath.Split.nonAuthorBps →
      amount / 5 < BucketMath.Split.uint256Bound ∧
        amount / BucketMath.Split.bpsDenominator * nodeBps < BucketMath.Split.uint256Bound ∧
          amount % BucketMath.Split.bpsDenominator * nodeBps < BucketMath.Split.uint256Bound

name: BucketMath.Split.nodePart
type: Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat

name: BucketMath.Split.nodePart_le
type:
∀ (nodeBps nodeFloor amount : Nat),
  nodeBps ≤ BucketMath.Split.nonAuthorBps →
    BucketMath.Split.nodePart nodeBps nodeFloor amount ≤ BucketMath.Split.nonAuthor amount

name: BucketMath.Split.nodePart_without_overflow
type:
∀ (nodeBps nodeFloor amount : Nat),
  nodeFloor ≤ amount →
    BucketMath.Split.nodePart nodeBps nodeFloor amount =
      amount / BucketMath.Split.bpsDenominator * nodeBps +
        amount % BucketMath.Split.bpsDenominator * nodeBps / BucketMath.Split.bpsDenominator

name: BucketMath.Split.node_share_le
type:
∀ (nodeBps nodeFloor amount : Nat),
  BucketMath.Split.bpsDenominator * (BucketMath.Split.split nodeBps nodeFloor amount).node ≤ nodeBps * amount

name: BucketMath.Split.node_zero_below_floor
type: ∀ (nodeBps nodeFloor amount : Nat), amount < nodeFloor → (BucketMath.Split.split nodeBps nodeFloor amount).node = 0

name: BucketMath.Split.nonAuthor_eq_div_five
type: ∀ (amount : Nat), BucketMath.Split.nonAuthor amount = amount / 5

name: BucketMath.Split.nonAuthor_le
type: ∀ (amount : Nat), BucketMath.Split.nonAuthor amount ≤ amount

type: ∀ (xs : List Rat), xs ≠ [] → BucketMath.Vec.sum (List.map (fun x => x - BucketMath.Vec.sum xs / ↑xs.length) xs) = 0

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot
type: List Rat → List Rat → Rat

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot_comm
type: ∀ (a b : List Rat), BucketMath.Vec.dot a b = BucketMath.Vec.dot b a

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot_smul_left
type: ∀ (c : Rat) (a b : List Rat), BucketMath.Vec.dot (BucketMath.Vec.smul c a) b = c * BucketMath.Vec.dot a b

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot_smul_right
type: ∀ (c : Rat) (a b : List Rat), BucketMath.Vec.dot a (BucketMath.Vec.smul c b) = c * BucketMath.Vec.dot a b

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot_sub_left
type:
∀ (a b c : List Rat),
  a.length = b.length → BucketMath.Vec.dot (BucketMath.Vec.sub a b) c = BucketMath.Vec.dot a c - BucketMath.Vec.dot b c

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot_sub_right
type:
∀ (a b c : List Rat),
  b.length = c.length → BucketMath.Vec.dot a (BucketMath.Vec.sub b c) = BucketMath.Vec.dot a b - BucketMath.Vec.dot a c

name: BucketMath.Vec.length_smul
type: ∀ (c : Rat) (v : List Rat), (BucketMath.Vec.smul c v).length = v.length

name: BucketMath.Vec.length_sub
type: ∀ (a b : List Rat), a.length = b.length → (BucketMath.Vec.sub a b).length = a.length

type: Rat → List Rat → List Rat

name: BucketMath.Vec.sub
type: List Rat → List Rat → List Rat

name: BucketMath.Vec.sum
type: List Rat → Rat

name: BucketMath.Vec.sum_add
type:
∀ (a b : List Rat),
  a.length = b.length → BucketMath.Vec.sum (BucketMath.Vec.add a b) = BucketMath.Vec.sum a + BucketMath.Vec.sum b

name: BucketMath.Vec.sum_smul
type: ∀ (c : Rat) (a : List Rat), BucketMath.Vec.sum (BucketMath.Vec.smul c a) = c * BucketMath.Vec.sum a

name: BucketMath.Vec.sum_sub_const
type: ∀ (xs : List Rat) (c : Rat), BucketMath.Vec.sum (List.map (fun x => x - c) xs) = BucketMath.Vec.sum xs - ↑xs.length * c
